newspec-c: record-only → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only))
Our own addition: record-only, findings are suggestions. newspec-c/vis-tc04-s23-s24-quick-dictation-visual.spec.ts on desktop Chromium 1280x800, Pixel 7 Chromium and iPhone 15 WebKit (fresh account, 25 synthetic patients, one in room 415; Dictate never tapped, every ai/* action refused in the browser, tripwire clean). Typing 'Bed 415, stable.' showed the chip 'Rm 415' and 'Matches on your list' with '415 · QA TC04 Sloan … Link'. axe-core (WCAG 2 A/AA) on three states - qd-pad, qd-picker (Assign to patient open) and qd-error (a failed assign, the quickDictation:assign mutation failed at the socket): the only serious/critical violation is color-contrast (pad: 1-2 nodes, the 'Matches on your list' header and the footer hint; picker: 10-14 nodes, the grey '— diagnosis' text in each row; A4). Accessible names on all profiles: dialog 'Quick dictation' (aria-labelledby, as known), Dictate, Assign to patient, Link (named by its row text '415 · <name> Link'), Delete compartment, Close quick dictation, New compartment, Close picker. Not met (suggestions): the dictation box and the picker search are named only by their placeholder; the picker sheet has no dialog role of its own (focus does move to its search). The error is announced: the pad's own line '⚠ Couldn't assign the compartment — try again.' is a plain div, but the app's global banner 'The dictation couldn't be added to the patient's chart. Check your connection and try again.' is role=alert.

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S23 axe scan of the pad, the room chip with suggestion, and the open picker

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 4; TFA-92582 step 4; TFA-92583 AC 3)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual-lane fixture with a box reading 'Bed <fixture room>, stable.'

When Visual lane opens Quick Dictation, then the Assign to patient picker, and runs axe on each state

Then No serious/critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Dialog named 'Quick dictation'; Dictate, Assign to patient, Link, Delete compartment, Close and New compartment have accessible names; the box and the picker search have a name (not only a placeholder); the error message is announced

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core serious/critical violations = 0 per state (visual-checks.ts). The announcement of the failed-assign message (WCAG 4.1.3) is not covered by axe and is recorded

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
